svg.title: Drawing 01 — Annotated window typology — North Glasgow Window & Ventilation Programme
svg.desc: Window typology sheet: six typical opening types across the blocks drawn as elevations with opening lights, sizes and recorded exceptions keyed to the survey matrix, and a key plan of a block with window positions numbered.
svg.text: Typical types across the blocks. Sizes are nominal; every opening is measured and carried on the window schedule with its matrix reference.
KEY PLAN · TYPICAL BLOCK (WINDOWS NUMBERED ON THE SCHEDULE)
Front elevation: positions 1–9 (W2, W3, W1). Rear elevation: positions 10–18 (W4, W5, W1). Stair windows W6 at each close.
Survey matrix: one row per opening recording size, condition, ventilation provision and any deviation from the typical type.
Opening light: apex at the hinge side
North Glasgow Window & Ventilation Programme · Staging drawing set
